provenance.notes: Badge names compiled from maintainer familiarity with the Scouts BSA catalog and adjusted for 2025-2026 changes reported in news coverage and council communications. The official merit badge list on scouting.org could not be reached from the build environment, so every listing is marked unverified. Official URLs follow the scouting.org per-badge URL pattern and have not been fetched.
